recommendation: Keep the fix as-is. It removes the remaining active id-vs-Identifier ambiguity tied to FHIR-29690 without changing search semantics or expanding into broader reliable messaging issues.
issue_request: FHIR-29690 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. It asked whether MessageHeader.response.identifier should target an id or Identifier and resolved to change the element type from id to Identifier, with short and long descriptions updated to say it is the Bundle.identifier of the original message.
initial_application: The main element application was split across earlier source history: dd765a96beb1acc58f2276f9d6f6c3fa9e89b2fc changed MessageHeader.response.identifier from id to Identifier, and bce22083f1b66e65552b1bddcbcb812506c29e3b changed its short and definition to Bundle.identifier wording. The current messaging narrative also uses Bundle.identifier for message identity and for MessageHeader.response.identifier.
additional_context: The cited implementers Zulip thread supports Bundle.identifier because Bundle.id can change while messages traverse routing hops. FHIR-I January 2021 minutes confirm the Persuasive with Mod vote and note that both short and long descriptions should be updated. Related FHIR-25460/FHIR-25461 messaging-identifier discussions support the current Bundle.identifier identity model but were broader than this seed reconciliation.
reconciliation: Changed source/messageheader/bundle-MessageHeader-search-params.xml so the active MessageHeader-response-id SearchParameter description no longer says "Id of original message" and instead says "Bundle.identifier of original message". The search parameter code response-id and token expression were intentionally left unchanged.
source_changes: source/messageheader/bundle-MessageHeader-search-params.xml: changed the MessageHeader-response-id SearchParameter description from "Id of original message" to "Bundle.identifier of original message".

related_jiras.note: Reliable messaging wording was updated to use Bundle.identifier and supports the current messaging identity model, but the issue covers broader reliable messaging prose beyond this seed.
Later no-change decision says Bundle.identifier/reliable messaging concerns had been addressed by other trackers, supporting this bounded cleanup rather than another broad change.
